judgement.reason: The outcome of deployable with changes fits: the Dockerfile installs a released tarball instead of building this source, and a contained Dockerfile rewrite that copies the source and splits the supervisor programs fixes that.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: .docker/Dockerfile runs supervisord with a web server and a worker program (.docker/config/supervisord.conf) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile copies a supervisord config that runs php-fpm, nginx and a scheduler worker in one container, so the setup must be split into a web process and a separate worker.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares leantime_db (mysql:8.4) in .docker/docker-compose.yml; mariadb (a Helm dependency) in helm/Chart.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared services are MySQL (mysql:8.4 in the compose file) and an optional MariaDB Helm dependency, so they map to the managed MySQL that Deployz provides.
